Ten comments

Paddy O’Rafferty’s

From the playing of Celtic Crossroads.

Third (last) tune in their set titled “The Jigs”, on their album “The Unique Irish Music Experience”.

Two-part variant of the tunes Paddy O’Rafferty’s and Paudeen O’Rafferty’s, which are both currently residing at:
https://thesession.org/tunes/741

Some additional information on this variant is available at Irish Tune Info:
https://www.irishtune.info/tune/4567/

↳ Posted by NfldWhistler on January 2nd, 2020.
